notes: The three-daily report automation was observed configured for 06:00,14:00,22:00 in the current Central-time environment. Configuration is not an actual execution or punctual-publication guarantee.
Weekday daily editions cover 24 elapsed hours; Saturday and Sunday daily editions cover 48 elapsed hours.
Calendar weekly and weekend editions close Monday at 00:00 and publish at 06:00 Chicago; fortnightly editions use the October 19, 2026 anchor and first close November 2.
Monthly and quarterly editions publish at 06:00 after the calendar period closes. Rolling six-month editions use the latest six completed calendar months and refresh monthly.
Planned slots and actual retrieval, compilation, publication and source clocks remain separate. Missed slots do not trigger an unbounded backfill burst.
